consumer: The dialogue/condition has_items check (conditional_t::set_has_items lambda) asking 'is the avatar carrying the contraband item?' for the border guard's search
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession), as the engine's has_charges/has_amount predicate computes it
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its lambda returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, the engine-computed possession verdict the guard's check consumes
divergence: Contraband stashed inside a carried gun or magazine: the engine possession predicate counts it as carried, but a re-derivation from the avatar.carried_items[] snapshot misses it because visit_internal stops descending into gun/magazine contents, so the snapshot-derived answer says 'not carrying' while the truth is 'carrying'
